definition: The period of time and location in which [player](/term/player) vs. player [combat](/term/combat) occurs. A fight can occur at several scales, with additional descriptors depending on the encounter's duration and the number of champions involved. Fights are discrete: they have definitive endpoints and are locally contained around the action, though fights can drift and move accordingly. Periods of combat or [tension](/term/tension) without definitive endpoints are labeled differently, though they can also be called fights.
